data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-f-r' meaning 'to protect, shield, preserve'. In Islamic context, Mahparah symbolizes the belief in divine protection and the responsibility of being a guardian for others. The name Mahparah carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahparah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
